title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-agenda-prep-2026-06-08
content:
Weekly sync – Serving Runtime / Infra / Console – Agenda & personal prep
Date: 2026-06-08
Time: 10:00–10:45 PT
Location: Zoom + recording in #serving-runtime
Organizer / owner: Alex Chen (me)
Attendees (expected): Priya, Diego, Jordan, Samira, SRE on-call (TBD)
Goal for this meeting: quick alignment on blockers, validation plan for the new routing fallback, and rollout schedule for console feature flags. Keep to 45m, surface blockers that need follow-up outside the meeting.

1) Quick updates (10m) – round robin
  - Alex: rollout health + fallback testing status (see PR + perf dashboard)
  - Priya: autoscaler tuning + capacity plan for Dedicated pools
  - Diego: KV cache perf regression investigation (p95 increase)
  - Jordan: console feature-flag rollout and telemetry gaps

2) Incidents / Reliability highlights (8m)
  - KV cache p95 regression last 48h (ENGINF-842) – current hypothesis: GC/fragmentation on quantized runs. Dice to explain findings and next steps.
  - Recent minor servicer OOM on smaller models during burst window – temporary mitigation applied on 2026-06-05.

3) Routing & fallback rollout (10m)
  - Status: canary ran yesterday (small sample 2h) – no functional failures but latency bump on long-context traces.
  - Action: decide whether to extend canary to 24h or rollback to previous routing policy.
  - Notes: need to run prefix-cache enabled test + KV cache disabled baseline to isolate.
  - Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/789

4) Console + observability (8m)
  - Jordan: telemetry gap for per-route token-cost broken out by quant profile – plan to add new metric (CONFL-1123).
  - UX note: users reported confusing error when model variant fallback occurs – Samira to draft copy for banner.

5) Action-item review + prioritization (7m)
  - Quick pass on outstanding items from last week, call out owners and adjust due dates.

Parking lot / outside meeting follow-ups:
  - deeper KV cache perf postmortem (Diego to lead; request SRE and applied-ml input)
  - autoscaler policy tuning doc (Priya + infra)
  - rollback criteria doc for routing changes (Alex + product)

Previous action items (brief):
  - Alex: run extended fallback canary + collect traces – in_progress (collected 2h canary; need 24h) – note: prefer to extend canary if SRE ok.
  - Priya: bump Dedicated autoscaler target for beta customers – done (rolled out 2026-06-04)
  - Diego: initial heap/profile dump + flamegraphs for KV cache p95 – in_progress (have heap dump; analyzing)
  - Jordan: patch to console to surface fallback reason in request detail – in_review (PR staged)
  - Samira: draft banner copy for fallback UX – todo (will present in meeting)

New action items (to capture during/after meeting):
  - AI-01: Extend routing fallback canary to 24h; collect prefix-cache on/off traces and KV cache metrics – owner: Alex – due: 2026-06-09 – jira: ENGINF-853
  - AI-02: Produce KV cache perf postmortem with timeline + repro steps – owner: Diego – due: 2026-06-11 – jira: ENGINF-842
  - AI-03: Update autoscaler tuning doc with burst policy recommendations and cost estimates – owner: Priya – due: 2026-06-12 – jira: ENGOPS-319
  - AI-04: Add telemetry for per-route quant-profile token-cost and a dashboard stub – owner: Jordan – due: 2026-06-15 – linked: CONFL-1123
  - AI-05: Draft user-facing banner copy explaining fallback behavior + opt-out instructions – owner: Samira – due: 2026-06-09

Questions / asks for meeting:
  - From SRE: estimate risk of extending canary to 24h given upcoming infra maintenance on 2026-06-10.
  - From applied-ml: could quantization changes account for p95 spike? need short checklist for reproducing with/without quant profiles.
  - From product: confirm rollback window and communication plan for customer-facing incidents.

Notes to self (Alex) – things to bring up explicitly:
  - Emphasize we need the 24h canary to get better tail metrics – short canaries miss rare tail events.
  - Ask Samira to keep banner copy minimal and include link to status page.
  - If p95 regression correlates with quant-profile X, consider temporary routing to unquantized variant for affected customers.

Prep checklist (pre-meeting):
  - Attach 2h canary traces to agenda doc (done)
  - Confirm SRE on-call availability (pinged @sre-oncall)
  - Pull latest dashboard links into Slack thread and the meeting invite

Meeting outcomes to capture after the call:
  - Decision on canary extension (extend / rollback / hold)
  - Owners assigned + dates (update Jira tickets)
  - Follow-up doc links posted to #serving-runtime and Confluence

---
Scratch notes / shorthand (internal):
  - If Diego's flamegraphs point to allocator churn, ask about jemalloc tuning or migrating to tcmalloc in the hot path.
  - Cost implication of long canary: compute token-hours and expected bump in Dedicated pool usage. Priya to estimate.
  - UX: keep language "automatic fallback to compatible model variant" to avoid implying degraded accuracy.

References / links to keep handy:
  - Canary traces: https://observability.redwood.com/dashboards/canary/2026-06-07
  - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/789
  - Jira: ENGINF-842 (KV cache p95), ENGINF-853 (routing canary), ENGOPS-319 (autoscaler)
